2024-06-18 | #009  

New SAV from 5th August 2024

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-009_New-SAV_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. We’re pleased to announce the release of a redesigned SAV used as a standalone product as well as in combination with the FRM and FRM-NOC. This new design brings a more robust construction, with improved performance and a reduction in types maintaining the same operating ranges for over and under pressure protection.

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-009_New-SAV_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. The ordering article numbers won’t change for FRM and FRM-NOC. And for the SAV as stand-alone product, there will be no new articles neither, just a reduction of the total amount. Now there will be a combination of ND-MD type and HD-UHD type. For all those products, all deliveries starting from 5th August 2024 will be done with the new design. Please find at the end of the document information about new spring ranges and the external dimensions in comparison to the current ones.

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-009_New-SAV_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. With the new replacement ASE, you’ll need to specify the type of fittings you require. Whether if it’s for the US market, CE markets or for a FRM-NOC with internal impulse. Those connections are now part of the configuration of the article and there are 3 alternatives:

1. Ext-EU: Impulse lines fittings for 12mm pipe and atmospheric connections G type (ISO228/1)

2. Ext-US: Impulse lines fittings for ½” OD pipe and atmospheric connections NPT

3. Int: For FRM-NOC with internal impulse.

1R0

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-009_New-SAV_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. Ordering process during transition phase

FRM and FRM-NOC orders can be ordered normally at any time. Any delivered unit from the 5th August 2024 on will be assembled with the new design of the SAV. In that case, the SAV settings will be maintained, but be aware that the spring range will change to the new ones.

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-009_New-SAV_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. SAVs that will be phased out (see previous list), can be ordered until 5th July 2024. From 6th July 2024, the article number must be changed to the equivalent replacement. Please consider the new spring and setting ranges.

New articles (replacement parts) can be ordered beginning of July, but deliveries starting from 5th August 2024.

1R0

2024-06-18 | #009  

Reed contact for new SAV

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-009_New-SAV_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. With the launch of the new SAV, we’re pleased to announce a new feature for this. The reed contact is an accessory to mount on the SAV to give an electrical signal whether SAV is in open or closed position.

The kit includes the sensor, a magnetic counterpart to be threaded on the shaft and a different protecting cap where the sensor is installed. On our web site you can find the related documentation following the link:

https://www.dungs.com/en/productgroups/accessories
